contact.evidence_quote: - John Cumming, Founder of POWDR ... John Cumming is POWDR’s founder and chairman. John and his brother, David Cumming, grew up in the mountains and in mountain communities. John’s deep appreciation of the mountain life was the impetus for him to become a climbing guide for Rainier Mountaineering Incorporated and later to be a founding shareholder at Mountain Hardwear before founding POWDR in 1994.
